title: Compact Reasoning Loop Input
description: Host-owned route state for scripts/run-loop.mjs. The runner derives DecisionBrief boilerplate, routes deterministically, builds and validates the public packet, and creates provisional APPLY actions.

context.description: Optional supplemental Jev context nested under public state.context by the runner. Share only material safe for the provider; never include raw private chain-of-thought.

cot.description: Compact shareable reasoning trace or decision brief, never raw private chain-of-thought.

thinking.description: Shareable summary of current beliefs or considerations, never hidden internal reasoning.

context.description: Task, conversation, memory, tool, or agent context relevant to this judgment.

reasoning.description: Optional bounded reasoning summary for agentic context, never hidden chain-of-thought or private scratch. The runner derives observations and uncertainty when omitted. Omit predictions and falsifiers unless meaningful; testable hypotheses keep required precommitments in state.

state.description: The route-specific public state validated by the existing route contract.

actions.description: Optional host overrides keyed by question ID. Omit with netAction to use deterministic actions derived from supplied state.
